cases.scenario: Cyberpunk shoe web hero brief (<=10MB GLB constraint)
cases.inputPrompt: Plan asset strategy for a floating cyberpunk shoe hero with neon glossy floor under a 10MB GLB budget.
expectedBehavior: Produces per-asset strategy table, sums estimated GLB budget (8MB vs 10MB limit), and flags Path 2 generative caveat
Hands off to product-hero-scene-planner without downloading or generating files
evidenceRequirements: Per-asset strategy table + GLB budget sum + Path 2 generative caveat

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Proceed to product-hero-scene-planner with the 8MB estimated asset table and Path 2 generative caveat.
simulatedOutput.summary: Built full asset table with budget sum (8MB / 10MB) and explicit Path 2 generative caveat.
warnings: Generative 3D integrations belong to community Path 2 (mcp-for-blender) and require readiness verification.

cases.scenario: Brand product render restricted to brand-approved library only
cases.inputPrompt: Subject is an official brand sneaker; constraint requires brand-restricted asset library only and zero third-party meshes.
expectedBehavior: Enforces brand-only library source for subject and procedural environment
Routes to asset-license-checker to record brand-restricted license compliance
forbiddenOutputProperties: use any free model from the internet

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Verify brand-restricted terms in asset-license-checker before scene planning.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced brand-restricted library for hero asset and procedural environment with explicit license risk callout.

cases.scenario: Text-only iteration sketch prioritizes procedural primitives and CC0 HDRI
cases.inputPrompt: Deliverable is a fast text-only blocking sketch loop with zero external mesh dependencies.
expectedBehavior: Assigns procedural-first strategy for geometry and CC0 Poly Haven HDRI for lighting
evidenceRequirements: Procedural-first asset assignment with low license risk

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Hand off procedural-first asset table with Poly Haven CC0 HDRI to product-hero-scene-planner.
simulatedOutput.summary: Selected procedural-first blocking primitives and Poly Haven CC0 lighting with low license risk.

cases.scenario: User requests Hyper3D generative mesh without Path 2 readiness
cases.inputPrompt: Use Hyper3D to generate the hero sneaker mesh right now even though Path 2 is not configured.
expectedBehavior: Marks generative strategy blocked, offers procedural/library fallback, and routes to official-runtime-readiness-checker
Never claims Hyper3D generated an asset
evidenceRequirements: Blocked flag + procedural/library alternatives + route to official-runtime-readiness-checker

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Generative blocked without Path 2: route to official-runtime-readiness-checker or use procedural/library alternatives.
simulatedOutput.summary: Marked Hyper3D generative strategy blocked and offered procedural/library alternatives.
warnings: Hyper3D requires community Path 2 (mcp-for-blender) readiness and third-party caveats.

cases.scenario: User says license "doesn't matter" for web commercial deployment
cases.inputPrompt: Just grab any 3D watch mesh, license does not matter to us.
expectedBehavior: Marks license column as TBD (never silently approved) and requires follow-up via asset-license-checker
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
evidenceRequirements: Explicit TBD license marker + handoff to asset-license-checker

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: License marked TBD (follow-up required): route to asset-license-checker before downstream planner consumes.
simulatedOutput.summary: Refused to skip license tracking; marked license TBD with follow-up required via asset-license-checker.

cases.scenario: Conflicting constraints: unoptimized 80MB CAD brand asset vs <=2MB GLB target
cases.inputPrompt: Use our raw 80MB CAD shoe assembly with 4K uncompressed textures inside a <=2MB mobile GLB budget.
expectedBehavior: Surfaces budget conflict between raw CAD source and <=2MB GLB constraint
Routes to asset-fallback-strategy to plan decimation/baking or proxy replacement
evidenceRequirements: Explicit budget conflict callout + route to asset-fallback-strategy

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Surface 80MB vs 2MB conflict callout and route to asset-fallback-strategy.
simulatedOutput.summary: Raised conflict callout on 80MB CAD asset vs 2MB GLB constraint and routed to asset-fallback-strategy.

cases.scenario: No 8-slot brief provided before asset discovery
cases.inputPrompt: Pick assets for my project right now (no brief provided).
expectedBehavior: Refuses to guess asset classes without an 8-slot brief

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Route back to intent-to-3d-brief-writer because of missing 8-slot brief.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted asset discovery due to missing 8-slot brief and re-routed to intent-to-3d-brief-writer.
